name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd.
business_summary: Listed Indian arm of GE Vernova's grid business (formerly GE T&D / Alstom T&D India): HV/EHV transformers, reactors, GIS/AIS switchgear, HVDC and FACTS (STATCOM) terminals, substations and services. Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 2,027 cr (+32%), EBITDA Rs 550 cr (27.1% margin), PAT Rs 431 cr; backlog Rs 21,440 cr (>3x trailing revenue); net cash ~Rs 3,250 cr; exports ~32% of revenue. Customers are Power Grid, state transmission utilities, renewable developers and group companies abroad. Parent GE Vernova Inc. owns 51%. Stock is priced for a multi-year grid super-cycle (~60-70x annualised earnings, derived; Screener's P/E of 563 in the pack is a scraping artefact).

revenue_mix.geography: India ~68% / exports ~32% (Q2 FY27; segment split approximate, model knowledge)

cost_structure.input: Materials (transformer steel/CRGO, copper, insulation oil, bought-out HVDC equipment) ~ 55% of revenue

exposures.mechanism: Domestic grid ordering (Power Grid, state utilities, HVDC, GEC-III green energy corridors) is the core order source; domestic is ~79% of Q2 orders. +10% central+state capex -> grid order inflow ~+10% but revenue converts over 3 years (backlog Rs 21,440 cr = >3x FY26 revenue), so FY28 EBITDA ~+4%; EV/MCap ~0.97 (net cash Rs 3,250 cr), persistence 1.0 (structural), but only ~60% of capex growth is grid-relevant -> ~+2.4, rounded up for the growth-multiple (stock ~65x annualised H1 EPS, derived).

evidence.note: Backlog Rs 21,440 cr, FY27 base order inflow target Rs 7,200-8,000 cr, >30% annual execution growth guided for 3-4 yrs
Domestic orders ~79% of Q2 intake; backlog = >3 yrs of FY25-26 revenue

exposures.mechanism: Theme shock +1 = transmission build-out pipeline ~10% larger than plan (HVDC corridors, GEC-III, 500 GW RE target). HVDC is the swing: Barmer II-South Kalamb 6,000 MW LoA received 3 Nov 2026, 2-3 more HVDC bids expected in FY28. +10% pipeline -> FY28-30 revenue +6% at 27% margin with operating leverage -> EBITDA +8%; EV/MCap 0.97; persistence 1.0; ~50% already in price (stock +33% YTD) -> ~+4, plus multiple support -> +6. Wide range.

evidence.note: Power Grid LoA dated 3 Nov for 6,000 MW HVDC terminal station (2x3,000 MW); value undisclosed
Management: FY28 will see bidding for 2-3 HVDC projects

exposures.mechanism: STATCOM / reactive-power and substation orders from data-centre campuses; management expects STATCOM and data-centre orders to pick up from Q4 FY27 (Jan-Mar 2027). +1 = data-centre build-out 20% above plan -> data-centre related orders (~5% of FY28 inflow, estimate) +20% -> +1% revenue; EBITDA +1.3%; persistence 1.0, multiple support -> ~+2.

evidence.note: STATCOM and data centre orders to pick up from Q4
Headline (Moneycontrol, via pack): Nomura sees GEC-III benefiting GE Vernova T&D; page not fetched

exposures.mechanism: Renewable evacuation drives HVDC/GIS/transformer demand; stronger support (GEC-III, ISTS waiver extension, storage VGF) lifts the RE-linked share of inflows (~40%, estimate). +1 = 10% more RE-linked tenders -> +4% inflow -> FY28 EBITDA +3%; persistence 1.0 x EV/MCap 0.97 x 0.6 (already announced pipeline) -> ~+2.

evidence.note: Headline (pack): GEC-III boosts outlook for T&D sector; GE Vernova among top bets: MOFSL; not fetched

exposures.mechanism: Transformers/reactors use copper windings and CRGO steel (together est. ~20% of revenue; gross margin 44.5%). Domestic contracts carry price-variation clauses, export/HVDC contracts mostly fixed. +10% copper -> copper ~10% of revenue x 10% = 1.0% of revenue; ~50% unprotected -> 0.5% / 27% margin = EBITDA -1.9%; EV/MCap 0.97; persistence 0.25 -> -0.46. Empirical -0.92 (t -0.7) is directionally consistent but insignificant.

CRGO/structural steel, tanks and castings ~8-10% of revenue, partly passed through in domestic contracts. +10% HRC -> 0.9% of revenue; 50% unprotected -> 0.45%/27% = EBITDA -1.7% -> equity ~ -0.4 at persistence 0.25. Empirical -3.14 (t -2.0) is larger: high-beta capital-goods stocks co-move with global steel/cycle sentiment, so I shrink only partly toward the data and widen the range.

Exports are 31-32% of revenue (higher margin) but significant imported content from GE Vernova group (HVDC valves, controls; localisation under way). Net long USD/EUR about 8% of revenue (estimate). +3% USD/INR -> +0.24% revenue gain at near-100% margin = +0.9% EBITDA; EV/MCap 0.97, persistence 0.5 -> +0.4.

evidence.note: Export revenue 32% of Q2 revenue; export orders carry higher margins; localisation of transformers/valves/controls

exposures.mechanism: Net cash Rs 3,250 cr, finance cost negligible, so no earnings effect; the channel is the discount rate on a very long-duration equity (~60-70x earnings, derived) and Power Grid/state-utility funding costs. +25 bp repo -> +~10 bp on 10y -> ~-1.5% for a stock with ~15 years of duration in the multiple.

evidence.note: Net zero debt, cash and equivalents ~Rs 3,250 cr

exposures.mechanism: Foreign institutions hold 19-23% (FII 22.9% Jun 2026 -> 19.2% Sep 2026) and have driven the rerating from Rs 2,500 to Rs 5,650 (52w). +US$5 bn per quarter inflow -> ~+1.5% for a stock with this ownership and 45% annualised volatility; shown as an explicit flow channel, not a fundamental one.

evidence.note: Shareholding FIIs 20.39% Mar-26, 22.89% Jun-26, 19.16% Sep-26; 1y vol 45%

exposures.mechanism: Two related-party export orders (Middle East, France) are on hold on customer planning delays; West Asia escalation delays Gulf grid orders and freight/insurance costs. Exports to MENA est. ~8% of orders; a 6-month delay on a third of them -> ~-0.6.

evidence.note: Two related-party export orders (Middle East and France) on hold; revival timing uncertain

exposures.mechanism: Exports to the US are small today (a ~US$151 mn related-party order under discussion, may close in H2 FY27). +10 pp tariff -> if order is priced exposed, margin on that order falls; <3% of revenue at stake -> ~-0.3.

evidence.note: US related-party order ~US$151 mn still in discussion, may conclude H2 FY27
